justification: Config-only scope evidence for three councils, four corrected scopes, a read-only probe for five logged defects, and a fallback reading in the fidelity probe. Nothing served changes until a production retag, which is held for the user's go. Not Critical because no row is written here.

pre_impl.existing_data: COUNCIL_CONFIGS entries for woollahra, canterbury_bankstown, parramatta; regulatory_provisions served rows tagged from them.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A Parramatta Part 3/4 entry would replace text-derived dev types with ALL; tests/test_parramatta_numbered_parts_scope.py caught it and the entries were removed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to existing rows only after retag_applicability_slug_docids.py --apply; dry run: 26 served rows narrow (E8 12, F2 9, D4 5).

functions.name: chapter_text
functions.input: a registry chapter dict with its public PDF url, fetched into the cache
functions.if_none: PyMuPDF absent -> pdfplumber text alone, as before

queries.purpose: served rows carrying raw table markup (DQ-125)
queries.where_clause: is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND provision_text LIKE '%<table%'
queries.if_wrong: over-counts if a view renders the markup; recorded in the tracker as not yet checked

break_it.scenario: A narrowed scope hides a rule from a development type the chapter covers
break_it.what_happens: a planner is not shown a binding control
break_it.how: E8 narrowed only to its own nine listed types, omitting only types the serving taxonomy cannot select; F2 to the one use it names
break_it.repro: retag dry run lists all 26 narrowings

break_it.scenario: A config entry for a whole-DCP Part replaces text-derived dev types with ALL
break_it.what_happens: rows lose their specific development types and show for everything
break_it.how: Parramatta Parts 3/4 entries removed after the test failed

break_it.scenario: The PyMuPDF fallback marks a quote OK that is not in the document
break_it.what_happens: a false scope sentence passes the fidelity check
break_it.how: the quote must still appear contiguously in one reading of the same PDF; the fallback only adds text from that file

post_merge.manual_verify: Production retag for woollahra, canterbury_bankstown, parramatta needs the user's go

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Before this branch Woollahra B1 and D1 read MISSING (2 spans, quotes paraphrased with bracketed ellipses) and Canterbury 7.5's sentence could not be found by pdfplumber; after: woollahra 65 OK/0 MISSING, canterbury-bankstown 34 OK/0 MISSING, parramatta 16 OK/0 MISSING.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: First woollahra run printed 'MISSING woollahra/parts/B1/applicable_zones' and 'MISSING woollahra/parts/D1/applicable_zones'; the five new dq_probe_app_defects checks each exit 1 against production today (2 of 5 addresses wrong, 8 names, unconditional note, 1064 rows, 30 rows).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Each council's own PDF in dcp_chapter_registry, and the live verify.plotdetect.com.au /api/property answer for DQ-122.
